ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(CITY OF KUALA LUMPUR) ORDER 2019

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 144/2019 published on 15 March 2019,

notice was given of the intention to make an order under section 70 of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Commissioner of the

City of Kuala Lumpur against the making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur, after consultation with the

Director General for Road Transport and after taking into consideration the matters

referred to in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (City of Kuala Lumpur) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 April 2019.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles specified in column (3) of the First Schedule on the part of

the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule as shown on the map in the

Second Schedule, otherwise than on the routes specified in column (2) of the

First Schedule, on the day and time specified in column (4) of the First Schedule,

is prohibited.
